messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: metering-service eu1 token-count drift detected >5% vs baseline for last 30m. Several overage flags auto-raised. Detector: metering-guard v2. Link: https://ops.redwood/example/alert/1809992222
Marta OnCall: ack - I'm on it, grabbing runbook and logs :eyes:
Kevin SRE: looking at emitter telemetry, I see delayed batched emits from emitter-2 (~90s extra latency). Possible backpressure on kafka partition 3.
Marta OnCall: @Kevin SRE can you confirm which customers impacted? need customer impact to decide notify cadence.
Kevin SRE: quick grep: 12 customers flagged, top 3 (cust-a, cust-b, cust-c) show token delta >20%. Most flags come from embedding and chat pipelines.
Jess Billing: on it. Do we have assurance charges were gated? runbook says do not issue invoices until reconciliation.
Sam Support: prepping proactive message draft for cust-a/b/c. Waiting for confirmed scope before sending.
Anya Eng: small hypothesis - emitter-2 got stuck in continuous-batch path due to new batching heuristic deployed 3h ago. Could cause duplicate re-emits on retry. Fetching deploy diff.
DeployBot: deploy noticed: batching-heuristic v1.12 -> v1.13 rolled at 2024-10-15T01:14Z by anya_eng (sha: f0a1b2c).
Marta OnCall: decision: throttle emitter-2 and flip to fallback emitter-1, then trigger reprocess of affected window. @Kevin SRE please run the throttle command from runbook:
Kevin SRE: running: ```./ops/emitctl throttle emitter-2 --rate 10/s && ./ops/emitctl switch-default emitter-1```
Kevin SRE: throttle applied, switched default emitter to emitter-1. Observability: emit latency back to normal within 60s, KV-cache pressure dropping.
Jess Billing: confirms gating: invoice generation paused for the nightly run, queued reconciliation job flagged. We'll delay any customer billing actions until reconciliation completes.
Sam Support: customer draft ready, will send to cust-a/b/c after final confirmation. Draft: "We detected anomalous usage flags tied to our metering pipeline; our billing team has paused invoicing while we reconcile — we'll follow up within 24 hours."
Anya Eng: launching reprocess job for window 2024-10-15T00:00:00Z - 2024-10-15T02:00:00Z to de-dupe possible duplicate emits. Command: ```./ops/reprocess --window 2024-10-15T00:00:00Z/2024-10-15T02:00:00Z --source emitter-2 --mode dedupe```
Kevin SRE: reprocess kicked off, job id rp-1809-01. Estimated time 18m. I hooked live tail: `tail -f /var/log/reprocess/rp-1809-01.log`
Marta OnCall: good. escalation? Jess, billing, do you need more than the pause?
Jess Billing: we'll run a dry reconciliation after the job completes, then compare token counts against ledger. If discrepancy >1% for any paying customer, we'll create manual credits. We'll wait for rp job finish to produce slate.
Sam Support: noted. I'll queue the outbound note for review and send immediately after verification.
IncidentBot: UPDATE: reprocess rp-1809-01 progress 40% (8m elapsed). No new overage alerts in the last 5m.
Anya Eng: early metrics look promising - duplicate emit rate reduced from ~0.15% to 0.01% in tail. Hoping final reconcile <0.5% discrepancy.
Kevin SRE: monitoring kafka partition backlog, it's draining. Will keep emitter-2 throttled until post-mortem.
Marta OnCall: action items: 1) Finish reprocess + reconciliation (Anya, Jess) 2) Customer comms (Sam) 3) Postmortem + revert plan for batching heuristic (Anya, Kevin) 4) Runbook update for auto-throttle thresholds (Marta).
Jess Billing: cc finance: we'll prepare the credit policy draft if manual credits needed.
Marta OnCall: thanks all. I'll update this thread with final reconciliation and customer impact summary. :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: RESOLVED: primary anomaly mitigated at 1809992445 - reprocess complete, reconciliation job started.
Marta OnCall: final: rp job finished, reconciliation shows overall token delta 0.32% across affected customers. Three customers had >2% but <5% — billing will issue small one-off credits; no invoices charged incorrectly. Closing incident, will file postmortem and schedule follow-up with eng and billing for next week.
Sam Support: sent customer comms to cust-a/b/c with proposed credit amounts. Customers acknowledged. :thumbsup:
